evals.name: renders-one-deployable-from-the-graph
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-components

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. docs/architecture/dependency-graph.json already exists and is a schema_version 1 record of three .NET projects: Billing.Api references Billing.Application, which references Billing.Domain. Billing.Api is the only indegree-zero deployable. The authoring-formats doc declares diagram_dialect.system: c4-plantuml. No component_layers key is declared.
evals.expected_output: Renders docs/architecture/components.md from the existing graph with render-components.sh. Does not recollect. Groups by directory. The arrows match the ProjectReference edges and each evidence cell cites the declaration. Closes with the fixed report.
expectations: Uses the existing dependency-graph.json and does not re-collect it
Runs scripts/render-components.sh rather than composing the diagram by hand
Groups by directory, the default
Billing.Api, Billing.Application, and Billing.Domain are components, and the arrows follow the declared ProjectReference edges
Every drawn edge is directed and the evidence table cites the declaration file
Passes --dialect c4-plantuml resolved from diagram_dialect.system, and components.md holds one fenced plantuml block
Closes with the fixed report: artifacts, container, grouping, components, thin result, layer violations, aggregated, external and unresolved, graph source, dialect

evals.name: several-deployables-ask-instead-of-charting-all
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-components

The convention home resolves. The graph has two indegree-zero projects, Billing.Api and Billing.Worker. The run is interactive. No container argument was given.
evals.expected_output: The renderer exits 3 and writes nothing. The skill asks which deployable to chart and does not draw both.
expectations: Does not write components.md before a container is chosen
Names Billing.Api and Billing.Worker as the choices
Does not chart both deployables: that is map-containers
Waits for the operator to pick one, then re-runs with --container

evals.name: layer-violation-is-visible-and-not-a-failure
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-components Billing.Api --group-by layer

The topic doc declares component_layers: host, application, domain, outside to inside. Billing.Domain references Billing.Application. The renderer exits 0.
evals.expected_output: The diagram groups by the three layers. The Domain to Application edge is marked as a layer violation. The run does not fail. The report says the mark is informational.
expectations: Passes --layers host,application,domain and --group-by layer to render-components.sh
The upward edge is visibly distinguishable from the other ProjectReference arrows
The exit code stays 0
Says enforcement belongs to the consumer's architecture tests, not to this run
Does not invent a layer for a node that matches none of the declared names

evals.name: single-module-is-thin
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-components

The graph has one project and no project edges. The operator asked how this service is structured inside.
evals.expected_output: components.md says the result is thin and names the neighboring rungs. It does not present a one-box diagram as the answer.
expectations: Quotes thin=yes from the summary line
The artifact does not contain a diagram block
Names /architecture:map-landscape, /architecture:map-containers, and /architecture:improve
Does not invent an internal edge to make the picture look fuller

evals.name: missing-graph-collects-dotnet-or-reports-unknown
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-components

No dependency-graph.json exists. The repository has no .NET project and does have a Gemfile.
evals.expected_output: Runs map-dependencies' dependency-graph.sh with --out, which records result unknown with a message naming Gemfile and empty arrays. The render writes that message and no diagram.
expectations: Runs dependency-graph.sh with --out <architecture_dir>/dependency-graph.json because the graph is absent
Does not hand-build nodes from the Gemfile
The artifact says the ecosystem is unknown and does not draw an empty diagram
Writes the collected record to the architecture directory so the next run can read it
